strengths: Concrete counter scenes and short scenario blocks read naturally.
Closing contrast (extraordinary outside / routine inside) fits magazine tone.

issues.problem: “When that story is live, see …” is draft/meta language, not published prose.
issues.suggestion: Use a normal cross-link sentence or drop the conditional publishing note entirely.

issues.problem: Long “Understanding why…” thesis sentence is slightly formulaic.
issues.suggestion: Tighten to traveler-facing outcomes: read the queue, use the counter, see the logistics.
